# Andalus Medical Center — a working demo by Desert Launch

> A working demo of a multi-specialty clinic website with its staff dashboard, by Desert Launch: doctors by specialty, a five-step booking flow with live availability, appointments and patient files. Fictional clinic, sample data.

A fictional business: the names, prices, address and phone numbers are invented, and the data is sample data that resets on refresh.

This is one of six live demos published by Desert Launch (https://www.desertlaunch.dev/), a software development company in Cairo, Egypt that builds mobile apps, web platforms, MVPs and internal business systems for clients in Egypt, the Gulf, Europe and the US. The demos exist so a prospective client can try the customer-facing flow and then see it arrive on the staff side. The full list, how to use them and what a real build adds: https://www.desertlaunch.dev/demos/ (Arabic: https://www.desertlaunch.dev/ar/demos/).

## What this demo is

- Kind of business portrayed: multi-specialty clinic, set in Abu Dhabi.
- Interface language: English.
- Everything runs in the browser against an in-memory store. There is no backend, no database, no accounts and no payments; nothing entered is sent anywhere, and a refresh resets the data.
- The demo is intentionally excluded from search engines (noindex) because it is not a real business.

## What works

- Doctors by specialty with profiles
- Five-step booking wizard with live slot availability
- First available slot across a whole department
- Deep links into booking by specialty or doctor
- Staff dashboard with full control over appointments and patient files
- Filters by status, department, doctor and date range

## Where to look

- / — home
- /specialties and /doctors — directories
- /book — the five-step booking flow
- /admin — staff dashboard
- /admin/appointments and /admin/patients
